figurative_meaning_en: rural or rustic; in a derogatory sense, uncouth or bumpkin
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা দেহাতি লোক, শহরের জীবন বুঝে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real dehati, doesn't understand city life.
Those dehati habits won't work here.
note: Often used to highlight the urban-rural cultural divide in Bengali society
